name: screenlasso
description: Edit, mark up and convert images, read text, work with colors and QR codes, and convert videos with the ScreenLasso app on your Mac: social media sizes, WebP and AVIF, arrows and numbered steps, HEX/OKLCH/Tailwind and WCAG contrast. Images never leave your Mac.

access_key.title: ScreenLasso key
access_key.description: Copy it from ScreenLasso › Settings › AI Agents, with Let AI agents use ScreenLasso turned on.

server_url.title: ScreenLasso address
server_url.description: Where ScreenLasso listens on this Mac. Leave it as it is unless Settings › AI Agents shows another address.
